display.purpose: Hero headline, section headlines, card/step titles. Never used for body copy.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, feature descriptions, FAQ answers. Set in Ink Soft.

label.purpose: Anything that reads as system-generated: nav links, buttons, tracking numbers, postmark ring text, pipeline status, footer columns. Always uppercase.

shadows.name: stamp
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Reserved for objects being 'pressed down' — hero demo card, primary CTAs, highlighted pricing tier. Never used for generic card lift.

motion.name: entrance-ease
motion.purpose: Standard scroll-reveal and section entrance easing (opacity + y translate).

motion.name: stamp-overshoot-ease
motion.purpose: Spring-overshoot easing used when a postmark ring stamps into place, giving it a punch/settle feel.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill CTA in Postmark Red with the stamp shadow; used for install/upgrade actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #c8401f; color: #faf5e9; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(33,26,18,0.08), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(33,26,18,0.35); transition: background 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9c2f15; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f3f6b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Pill ghost CTA with hairline border; paired alongside the primary CTA (e.g. 'Add to Comet').
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #faf5e9; color: #211a12; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 14px 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(33,26,18,0.2); transition: border-color 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(33,26,18,0.4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f3f6b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Bordered paper-light panel used for feature, step, and pricing content.
components.html:
It stamps itself.

Install the extension once. Every application gets logged instantly.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #faf5e9; border: 1px solid rgba(33,26,18,0.12); border-radius: 16px; padding: 28px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; color: #211a12; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: #4a4033; margin: 0; }

components.name: Postmark Stamp
components.description: Signature two-line rubber-stamp ring marking an automatic action ('APPLIED / AUTO'). The system's core automation indicator — reuse rather than inventing a new one.
components.css: .ds-postmark { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid #c8401f; color: #c8401f; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transform: rotate(-18deg); font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; background: transparent; } .ds-postmark-line1 { font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1; } .ds-postmark-line2 { font-size: 7px; line-height: 1; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Streak Day Dot
components.description: One day of the streak strip: mono day-letter above a ring that fills solid when stamped, dims when not.
components.css: .ds-streak-day { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-streak-label { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; color: rgba(74,64,51,0.7); } .ds-streak-ring { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(33,26,18,0.15); color: rgba(33,26,18,0.2); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-streak-ring--stamped { border-color: #c8401f; color: #c8401f; } .ds-streak-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #c8401f; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Mono uppercase nav link with a red underline that grows from the left on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #4a4033; text-decoration: none; padding: 4px 0; display: inline-block; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 1.5px; width: 0; background: #c8401f; transition: width 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #211a12; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f3f6b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: FAQ Accordion Item
components.description: Divided-list question row with a mono '+' ring that rotates to '×' and turns Postmark Red when open.
components.css: .ds-faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(33,26,18,0.12); } .ds-faq-question { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 20px 0; background: none; border: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: #211a12; } .ds-faq-toggle { flex-shrink: 0; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(33,26,18,0.25); color: #4a4033; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-faq-toggle--open { border-color: #c8401f; color: #c8401f; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-faq-question:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f3f6b; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Streakhire's world is a postal sorting facility: kraft paper, cancellation-mark ink, tracking numbers, and the specific choreography of a stamp coming down on a form. The system exists to make one claim visible without saying it in copy — that the application was processed by a machine, the instant it arrived, with no one standing over it. Every recurring device (the rotated postmark ring, the dashed cancellation lines, the diagonal airmail stripe) is a piece of sorting-room machinery doing real work, not a texture applied for mood.

The system explicitly refuses two defaults: the dark-SaaS-gradient hero (glossy, nocturnal, un-postal) and the cartoon-mascot gamification layer that most streak products reach for. Warmth here comes from paper and ink, not from a character. Density is unhurried — generous section padding (96–128px vertical rhythm), single-column focus per idea, and confident whitespace around the postmark set-pieces so the stamp motion has room to read.
keyCharacteristics: Kraft/paper ground with postmark-red ink as the sole loud color
Rubber-stamp rotation (−1.5° to −18°) as the physicality signal, not drop shadows
Airmail diagonal stripe used as a structural rule at world boundaries, never as decoration
Space Mono uppercase for anything that reads as a system label (tracking numbers, nav, badges)
No eyebrow/kicker labels above headings anywhere in the system

rules.name: The One Loud Color Rule
rules.body: Postmark Red is the only saturated, high-chroma color permitted to carry emphasis (CTAs, active states, the stamp itself). Airmail Blue and Offer Green are desaturated by comparison and restricted to structural or status roles — they never compete with red for attention.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Eyebrow/kicker labels above headings are banned system-wide. This was tried and deliberately removed during finish review — headings carry their own weight via Display type and don't need a small-caps label pointing at them first.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-System Rule
rules.body: Space Mono is reserved for anything that reads as machine-generated or systemic (tracking numbers, timestamps, nav, buttons, badges). Space Grotesk is reserved for anything authored (headlines, titles). Body copy never uses Mono.

rules.name: The Tilt-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Depth and physicality come from rotation (stamps, cards sitting slightly askew), not from shadow stacking. shadow-stamp is the only shadow in the system and it is used sparingly, on stamped/pressed objects only.

dos: Do treat the airmail-stripe diagonal as a structural boundary rule (navbar-on-scroll, hero top, footer top) — it marks a transition between world zones, never decorate a random section with it.
Do use rotation (−1.5° to −18°) to signal physicality on stamped/pressed elements instead of adding shadow.
Do set anything system-generated (tracking numbers, timestamps, nav, buttons, badges, pipeline status) in uppercase Space Mono.
Do reuse the postmark-ring + "APPLIED/AUTO" device for any new automatic-logging moment rather than inventing a second automation motif.
Do keep Postmark Red as the only saturated accent color on any given screen; let Airmail Blue and Offer Green stay administrative.
donts: Don't use a dark-gradient SaaS hero treatment — this system's hero is warm paper and ink, explicitly rejecting that default.
Don't introduce a cartoon mascot or character-based gamification device — the streak is expressed through the postmark/stamp vocabulary, not a character.
Don't add an eyebrow/kicker label above any heading — this was tried and removed in finish review; headings stand alone.
Don't apply generic ambient drop shadows to cards for "lift" — shadow-stamp is the only shadow in the system and it is reserved for stamped/pressed objects.
Don't square off buttons or badges — the pill/circle vocabulary (via rounded-full) is load-bearing to the postal-facility form language.
